sprint._todo: OQ-SPRINT-NUMBERS: every value below is a placeholder, not a design value. The forward threshold is a fraction of the stick radius; higher sprint sensitivity = lower threshold (docs/CONTROLS.md Sprint).

lock_target.note: centre of the lock target above the move-stick origin, in stick radii; its size as a fraction of the HUD height

lock_button.note: size of the movable Sprint lock button; its default position is touch_layout.sprint_lock_pos (G2L); always at least min_dp

radial_deadzone.note: applied to the vector's length (not per axis); the rest is rescaled to 0..1

layout_editor._todo: OQ-LAYOUT-EDITOR (G2e): every range below is a placeholder, not a design value and not PUBG's. size_pct is a percent of the element's default size; alpha_pct a percent of full opacity. An element's touch target never goes below min_target_dp, whatever the slider says.

check_sizes._note: Viewports checked for off-screen elements, landscape only (OQ-PORTRAIT): Fold cover, Fold inner, and the two small test sizes.

touch_layout._contrast_note: P0 playtest contrast: ring_alpha was 0.35 and the button idle fill 0.22 (too faint on the Fold). Values here are placeholders pending playtest (OQ-35).
touch_layout._sticks_todo: OQ-35: rest centres of the always-visible sticks are placeholders: [x as fraction of width, y as fraction of height]. G2L: move bottom-left; look bottom-right, with the button cluster north-west of it.
touch_layout._move_stick_note: Which move stick the touch HUD builds. 'virtual' (the default) = Godot 4.7 VirtualJoystick; 'custom' = the hand-written stick, kept as a working fallback. The player profile (Settings in the main menu) overrides this value. See docs/CONTROLS.md and OQ-VJOY.
touch_layout._vjoy_layout_note: Only used when move_stick is 'virtual'. 'floating' (default): JOYSTICK_DYNAMIC, a touch anywhere in the left half (move_zone) spawns the base under the thumb. 'fixed': JOYSTICK_FIXED at move_stick_rest, only touches on the stick grab it; other touches go to look.
touch_layout._vjoy_todo: OQ-VJOY: all values below are trial placeholders, not design values. Sizes are fractions of the custom stick radius / ring.
touch_layout._buttons_todo: OQ-35, G2L: button size, min_dp, font and offsets are placeholders, not design values. offset = [dx, dy] of the button centre from the look stick rest centre, in button sizes (negative = west/north). Keys of buttons are InputMap actions.
touch_layout._swap_shoulder_note: Path A phase 2 (Shibi GO via EL, Oct 27 2026): the Shoulder button flips the local camera between the right (default, camera.json shoulder_side) and left shoulder. View only, never sent to the host. Its offset (above Jump) is a placeholder, not a design value (OQ-SHOULDER). The WIP slot [-1.7, -2.4] (left of Jump, above Aim) covered the look-zone centre on the Fold inner display (2176x1812) and the (900, 300) look touch of the 1152x648 tests, so look touches there pressed Shoulder; right of Jump is not north-west of the look stick (G2L) and hit the gear at 420 dpi. -3.5 is the highest row that stays inside 1512x648 at 420 dpi. The swap_shoulder InputMap action has no keyboard or gamepad binding yet (OQ-SHOULDER).
touch_layout._sprint_lock_note: G2L: the one default position of the movable Sprint lock button, [x of width, y of height] of its centre. The profile value (sprint_lock_pos) overrides it. Its size and min_dp stay in sprint.lock_button.
touch_layout._left_fire_note: G3e: optional second Fire button for the left thumb, off by default. pos = [x of width, y of height] of its centre, on the left half above the move stick and clear of the Sprint lock target. Placeholder position, not a design value (OQ-LEFT-FIRE-POS). Not a key of buttons: those are InputMap actions; this one presses the existing fire action.

left_fire.note: optional second Fire button for the left thumb (G3e); size = button_size_frac_of_height, at least button_min_dp
